hints.title: Greedy Subarray Extension
hints.text: Extending the current subarray as far right as possible never hurts future subarray partitions.

hints.title: Running Subarray GCD
hints.text: Maintain the greatest common divisor cur_gcd of the active subarray. For next element x, calculate new_gcd = math.gcd(cur_gcd, x).

hints.title: Split Trigger
hints.text: If new_gcd equals 1, close the current subarray, start a new subarray with x, and increment the partition count.

hints.title: Greedy Contiguous GCD Partition Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass accumulating GCD in logarithmic steps per element.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Dynamic programming over all possible partition indices incurs unnecessary O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory operates directly on running scalar GCD.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies greedy single-pass extension to minimize subarray partitions.
